Source height/exclusion/residual totals and exact roof-triangle conservation belong to the independent full checker; this script does not repeat those full static audits.
The roof binary sidecars contain only actual Retained roof triangles for the independent roof comparator, not a second reconstructed mesh.
Owned GPU estimates are conservative buffer/image estimates, not a total process/driver memory measurement.
